policy: every committed evidence path must be relative, posix-normalized, inside the subject root, and a regular file
non_vacuity_proof: the traversal matcher is proven against a planted sample 'a/../../b' and the symlink check against os.path.islink on a planted link before scanning
scan_scope: the STAGED out-of-tree evidence set under evidence/; the committed tree is additionally validated by the publisher's path/symlink walk over every committed blob
committed_tree_validation: performed by the evidence pack before commit; the independent post-publication verifier reproduced CLEAN over all committed blobs
